obligations.expected_behavior: Reject an active requirement when its Acceptance is not observable.
forbidden_result: An active requirement with non-observable Acceptance is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: The VDD compiler reports the active requirement as rejected.
obligations.state_before: An active requirement has Acceptance that is not observable.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: An active requirement's Acceptance is not observable.

obligations.expected_behavior: Stop processing before making any semantic model call when deterministic source preflight fails.
forbidden_result: A semantic model call is made after deterministic source preflight failure.
Semantic processing continues after deterministic source preflight failure.
obligations.observable_result: Execution terminates before a semantic model call when deterministic source preflight fails.
obligations.state_after: Processing has stopped and no semantic model call has occurred.
obligations.state_before: Deterministic source preflight has failed and semantic model processing has not yet begun.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler

obligations.expected_behavior: Return a structured `repair-vdd` recommendation that identifies the blocking reason.
forbidden_result: The recommendation does not identify the blocking reason.
obligations.observable_result: A structured recommendation with the `repair-vdd` action and the blocking reason is returned.
obligations.state_after: The compiler returns a structured `repair-vdd` recommendation containing the blocking reason.
obligations.state_before: Compilation is blocked by a validation or deterministic source preflight failure.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: A blocking validation or deterministic source preflight failure prevents successful compilation.
